description: Details pursuant to the partial discharge of Condition 6 (part (i) a-c) of planning permission ref. 77146/APP/2023/3464 dated 19-01-2024 (Demolition of existing building and construction of a 3.no storey building to provide 9 units for supported living accommodation (retention of C2 use class)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: This application discharges Condition 6 point (i) A-C of planning consent reference 77146/APP/2023/3464 only. The remaining parts of the condition may need to be discharged if contaminated material is found during the construction of the development. If contaminated material is found details of the remediation will also need to be submitted.
